rows.quote: We included 51 644 individuals with both blood plasma protein data and pain questionnaire at baseline from the UK Biobank (UKB), aged from 39 to 70 at enrollment, comprising 54% women and 94% white individuals (Table S1, Supporting Information).
rows.coder_note: Rule C: the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data (application number 19542 in p002), defined by analytic sample (51 644) and the baseline pain questionnaire phenotype; no dictionary row is such an analysis and no candidate release is named.
